text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English.
zh: 你好，欢迎来到《简易英语》。
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎來到《簡易英語》。

text: In this podcast,
we have real conversations in easy English to help you learn.
zh: 我们用简单的英语进行真实对话，帮助你学习。
zh_hant: 我們用簡單的英語進行真實對話，幫助你學習。

text: I'm Neil.
And I'm Beth.
You can find a video version of this podcast
zh: 你可以找到这个播客的视频版本
zh_hant: 你可以找到這個播客的影片版本

text: and a free worksheet to help you learn on our website,
zh: 以及我们网站上的免费练习表，
zh_hant: 以及我們網站上的免費練習表，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
Hi Beth.
How are you?
I'm good, Neil.
How are you?
Very well, thank you.
What are we talking about today?
we are talking about housemates.
the people that you share a house with who aren't your family.
zh: 就是和你合住但不是家人的那些人。
zh_hant: 就是和你合住但不是家人的那些人。

text: Maybe they're your friends,
or even strangers who just need somewhere to live.
zh: 甚至是只想要个住处的陌生人。
zh_hant: 甚至是隻想要個住處的陌生人。

text: Exactly.
And it's quite common in the UK to live with housemates
zh: 在英国，和室友一起住很常见，
zh_hant: 在英國，和室友一起住很常見，

text: when you're younger.
Have you ever lived with housemates ?
Yes, of course.
I had house or flatmates when I was a student
zh: 我当学生的时候有室友或合租伙伴，
zh_hant: 我當學生的時候有室友或合租夥伴，

text: and then after I was a student
in my first jobs and before I got married.
zh: 在我第一份工作和结婚之前也有。
zh_hant: 在我第一份工作和結婚之前也有。

text: That's exactly the same as me.
So when I went to university,
zh: 所以我去上大学的时候，
zh_hant: 所以我去上大學的時候，

text: I moved in with five people,
zh: 我和五个人搬到了一起，
zh_hant: 我和五個人搬到了一起，

text: and we all had a separate room and a separate bathroom.
zh: 我们每个人都有独立的房间和独立的卫生间。
zh_hant: 我們每個人都有獨立的房間和獨立的衛生間。

text: But yeah, they were my flatmates for my first year of university.
zh: 不过，他们是我大学第一年的合租伙伴。
zh_hant: 不過，他們是我大學第一年的合租夥伴。

text: But in my second year,
then I moved into a house and we all shared a bathroom,
zh: 我搬进了一栋房子，我们共用一个卫生间，
zh_hant: 我搬進了一棟房子，我們共用一個衛生間，

text: and they were my housemates because we were in a house.
zh: 因为我们在房子里，所以他们就是我的室友。
zh_hant: 因為我們在房子裡，所以他們就是我的室友。

text: Did you enjoy having housemates?
zh: 你享受和室友一起住吗？
zh_hant: 你享受和室友一起住嗎？

text: I think it really depends on the people that you live with.
zh: 我觉得这真的取决于你一起住的人。
zh_hant: 我覺得這真的取決於你一起住的人。

text: I have had some bad housemates.
Bad because they weren't tidy, didn't clean.
zh: 不好是因为他们不整洁，不打扫。
zh_hant: 不好是因為他們不整潔，不打掃。

text: There were dishes in the kitchen
that were dirty and not cleaned for a long time.
But I've also had some really nice housemates
zh: 但我也遇到过一些非常好的室友，
zh_hant: 但我也遇到過一些非常好的室友，

text: as well.
I think, as you said, it really depends on the person,
zh: 我觉得，像你说的，这真的取决于人，
zh_hant: 我覺得，像你說的，這真的取決於人，

text: so you mentioned people being messy and that kind of thing.
zh: 你提到了邋遢之类的事情。
zh_hant: 你提到了邋遢之類的事情。

text: Also, noisy people are difficult.
zh: 还有，吵闹的人很难相处。
zh_hant: 還有，吵鬧的人很難相處。

text: But some of my best friends now
zh: 但我现在的一些好朋友，
zh_hant: 但我現在的一些好朋友，

text: have been my housemates in the past.
So I think
you can really get to know people very well,
zh: 你真的可以很深入地了解一个人，
zh_hant: 你真的可以很深入地瞭解一個人，

text: and you can also meet some people
zh: 同时你也会遇到一些人，
zh_hant: 同時你也會遇到一些人，

text: who you never want to see again in your life.
zh: 你一辈子再也不想见到他们。
zh_hant: 你一輩子再也不想見到他們。

text: That's true.
So, Neil, what do you think is the best
kind of personality,
the best kind of person to live with?
zh: 最好一起住的人是怎样的？
zh_hant: 最好一起住的人是怎樣的？

text: They have to be easy-going .
What does that mean?
Somebody who is easy-going is relaxed,
zh: 随和的人就是放松的人，
zh_hant: 隨和的人就是放鬆的人，

text: and they don't get too upset
zh: 他们不会因为小事太难过
zh_hant: 他們不會因為小事太難過

text: or angry over little things.
And they're quite easy to live with,
snd there's the clue – easy-going .
I think something else important about living with other
zh: 我觉得还有一点很重要，就是和别人一起住
zh_hant: 我覺得還有一點很重要，就是和別人一起住

text: people
or renting somewhere,
zh: 就是按月付钱，有个好房东。
zh_hant: 就是按月付錢，有個好房東。

text: so paying monthly, is having a good landlord.
It's very important.
So who is a landlord?
What is a landlord?
So the landlord is, or landlady,
is the person that owns the house or flat
zh: 就是拥有你住的房子或公寓的人，
zh_hant: 就是擁有你住的房子或公寓的人，

text: that you're in and you pay them rent.
So you pay them a monthly amount.
But you might live there for a year
or two years or three years,
but you don't own the place.
It's the landlord that owns the place.
zh: 拥有这个地方的是房东。
zh_hant: 擁有這個地方的是房東。

text: Yeah, and a good landlord can make a big difference.
zh: 是啊，一个好房东能带来很大的不同。
zh_hant: 是啊，一個好房東能帶來很大的不同。

text: Neil, are you easy to live with?
Should we be flatmates ?
I don't know,
but I think
I have made some good friends
when I've been a housemate.
So they think that I was a good housemate.
zh: 所以他们觉得我是个不错的室友。
zh_hant: 所以他們覺得我是個不錯的室友。

text: OK.
How about you?
Yeah, I think I'm easy to live with, but I like to sing a lot,
zh: 我觉得我容易相处，但我很喜欢唱歌，
zh_hant: 我覺得我容易相處，但我很喜歡唱歌，

text: so maybe people would tell me to be quiet.
zh: 所以可能有人会叫我安静点。
zh_hant: 所以可能有人會叫我安靜點。

text: Although no one's ever told me to be quiet,
but maybe they wanted me to and just didn't say.
zh: 但可能他们想让我安静，只是没说。
zh_hant: 但可能他們想讓我安靜，只是沒說。

text: Let's recap the vocabulary we've heard in this podcast,
zh: 让我们回顾一下这个播客里的词汇，
zh_hant: 讓我們回顧一下這個播客裡的詞彙，

text: starting with housemate.
A housemate is someone you
live with who probably isn't part of your family.
zh: 一起住的人，他可能不是你的家人。
zh_hant: 一起住的人，他可能不是你的家人。

text: We also hear flatmate.
And we had easy-going which means relaxed
and not easily upset.
or housemates often rent a property, and that means
zh: 或者室友常常租房，这意味着
zh_hant: 或者室友常常租房，這意味著

text: they don't own it – they pay money to the person who does own it.
zh: 他们不拥有房子——他们付钱给拥有房子的人。
zh_hant: 他們不擁有房子——他們付錢給擁有房子的人。

text: And the person who owns the house or flat is the landlord.
zh: 而拥有房子或公寓的人就是房东。
zh_hant: 而擁有房子或公寓的人就是房東。

text: That's who you pay every month and they own the property.
zh: 你每个月付钱给他们，他们拥有房产。
zh_hant: 你每個月付錢給他們，他們擁有房產。

text: That's it for this episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这一期《简易英语》就到这里。
zh_hant: 這一期《簡易英語》就到這裡。

text: To test what you've learnt, there's a worksheet on our website,
zh: 要测试你学到的内容，我们网站上有练习表，
zh_hant: 要測試你學到的內容，我們網站上有練習表，

text: bbclearningenglish.com.
And we'll be back next week with another easy English conversation.
zh: 下周我们会带着另一段简单的英语对话回来。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶著另一段簡單的英語對話回來。

text: Bye for now.
Goodbye.
